changelog:
**memora-knowledge-base v2.1.0**

- Entity extraction now processes all text chunks for the knowledge graph (no longer limited to 10 chunks).
- Document soft delete and purge also clean up associated Neo4j graph data for improved consistency.
- Fixed entity_id handling in API responses, resolving missing/mislabeled nodes in knowledge graph queries.
- Improved performance by moving MySQL-graph consistency checks to deletion instead of during queries.
- Skill directory and identifiers updated to memora-knowledge-base for ClawHub compatibility.
- Removed obsolete file: skill-card.md.
